maddeler.e:
أشمأز (form IVq)
# أُشْمَأَزُّ (ʔušmaʔazzu) /ʔuʃ.ma.ʔaz.zu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
# أُشْمَأَزَّ (ʔušmaʔazza) /ʔuʃ.ma.ʔaz.za/: first-person singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
# أُشْمَأَزِّ (ʔušmaʔazzi) /ʔuʃ.ma.ʔaz.zi/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
